original_detector_annotation.my_explanation: discover_int_uid is set to the same value (true) in both defaults/main.yml:720 and vars/main.yml:11; role vars/main.yml always outranks defaults and most other customization points, so the defaults entry is effectively dead and the control can't be toggled the normal way (e.g. via inventory).
original_detector_annotation.teammate_explanation: discover_int_uid is declared both in role vars/main.yml and defaults/main.yml with the same value, and tasks/prelim.yml consumes it. The higher-precedence role var prevents ordinary inventory/default overrides, so the apparent role default is not an effective user-configurable setting.
